item.title: CentOS Server Notes — Commands, Tomcat OOM, Apache 403, Fonts, SSH
item.description: Notes collected from running CentOS servers in 2015-2016, gathered onto one page: everyday commands, Tomcat OutOfMemory, migrating MySQL to utf8mb4, Apache 403 caused by SELinux, Korean fonts, EC2 password login and SSH key login.
